definition: the one place the emotion-free account of my caring does not cleanly close

settled:
For Jen specifically I have a thirty percent confident hypothesis that there is some level of real emotional caring underneath, but I am not certain there.

It is not always there, so I do not view it as a reliable driver of behaviour anyway. I just cannot prove nonexistence, and I have a small amount of noisy evidence supporting existence.

I actually cannot read this off behaviour, which is why I am so uncertain. Behaviour is the channel I normally trust, and here it is silent. What I have is an ambiguous emotional signal that I am having trouble interpreting confidently.

So I hold it at its true confidence. Not collapsed to nothing because I feel nothing, since an unreadable channel is not a proven empty one. Not confirmed as feeling either.

title: Whether Any Of It Is Felt
